summary: Sergio Perez won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 2.1s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Charles Leclerc completing the podium.
Esteban Ocon made the biggest climb, from P19 to P15.
Valtteri Bottas had a day to forget, dropping from P13 to P18.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 6 points over Sergio Perez.
